messages:
Ria: Quick ask for the Oct 5 benchmark webinar — can design deliver a tiny launch kit: hero slide, single-page PDF pocket guide, 4 square socials, 1 leaderboard, a compact infographic, and a decision mini-diagram?
Jamie: Got it. Exact sizes?
Ria: Hero 1920x1080, pocket A4 print@300, socials 1080x1080 x4, leaderboard 1200x628, infographic 600x900, diagram 800x600. SVGs for diagrams, PNG@2x for socials.
Oliver: Visual treatment?
Ria: Keep it brand v2: flat illustrations, navy + teal + sunrise accent. Minimal copy, technical tone. No photos.
Design-ops: Note: ensure 16px logo clearspace, include light/dark logo files. I'll attach brand tokens and a brief do/don't PDF.
Ria: Timeline: roughs in 48 hours, final assets 48 hours after copy lock. Hero + pocket guide first.
Jamie: For the infographic, want a latency vs cost sparkline with an annotated crossover where batching helps cost but adds latency?
Ria: Yes — annotate crossover with a percent label like "-30% cost" and a tiny arrow. Keep chart clean.
Oliver: Decision diagram should call out Hosted vs Dedicated with three micro-badges (quantized / fp16 / autoscale) and one-line notes.
Sam-bot: Template uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd-pocket-kit-template
Jamie: Scheduling a 20m review 10:30am PT tomorrow to walk roughs. RSVP please.
Ria: Thanks — ping if blocked on brand access. :rocket:
